procedures.name: Customer reply
procedures.description: Reads what the customer wants and how they feel, drafts an answer, checks it, and holds urgent ones for your OK.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Data processing agreement check
procedures.description: Checks a processor agreement against GDPR Article 28, lists the business risks at the same time, and writes a sign or do-not-sign memo.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Data subject request
procedures.description: Reads a GDPR request, answers that it arrived with the due date, waits for your OK, then reminds the team a week before the month is up.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Incident postmortem
procedures.description: A timeline and the causes worked out at the same time, actions that prevent a repeat, a blameless review, then the write-up.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Bug report triage
procedures.description: Rates a bug report, writes first steps for whoever is on call when it is critical, and turns it into a clean issue.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Release notes
procedures.description: Sorts a list of changes into new, fixed and breaking, writes notes for users, checks them against the list, then waits for your OK.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Competitor watch
procedures.description: Every Monday morning: what changed at your competitors last week, what it means for you, and what to act on.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Weekly numbers note
procedures.description: Works out the change in each number with a few lines of code, no model, then a resident writes what matters in it.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Posts from an article
procedures.description: Picks the ideas worth sharing, writes a LinkedIn post and short posts at the same time, checks them against the article, then waits for your OK.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Translation with a second reader
procedures.description: A translation, a second reader who compares it with the original, and a short glossary for next time.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Job posting and interview plan
procedures.description: Writes the posting and the interview plan at the same time, then checks the posting for words that put good people off.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Buyer lead reply
procedures.description: Reads a buyer's or tenant's inquiry, marks it hot, warm or cold from budget, timing and financing, and drafts a reply that offers viewings and asks what is missing.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Supplier invoice check
procedures.description: Reads a supplier invoice, checks the sums, the IBAN and the Romanian tax ID with code, writes the booking note, and holds doubtful invoices for your OK.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Patient message triage
procedures.description: Sorts a message to the clinic, sends emergencies straight to 112, drafts a reply that gives no diagnosis or dose, and waits for the clinic staff every time.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Payment reminders
procedures.description: Sorts unpaid invoices by how late they are with code, then writes a reminder for each customer in the right tone, checked and held for your OK.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Product page copy
procedures.description: Writes the title, bullets, description and meta description of a product from its specs, checked for claims the specs do not back, with the lengths measured by code.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Property listing
procedures.description: Turns an agent's notes into the facts of a property, a listing for the portals and a short social post, checked for invented facts and unfair wording.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Return or complaint
procedures.description: Sorts a shop customer's message into a withdrawal, a defect, a wrong item or a late delivery, says what the customer is owed, and drafts the reply; refunds wait for your OK.
procedures.author: SILO

procedures.name: Visit summary for the patient
procedures.description: Turns a doctor's visit notes into a plain-language summary for the patient, with nothing added that the notes do not say, checked against them, and signed off by the doctor.
procedures.author: SILO
